brief: Our gross margin has fallen from 46% to 39% over six quarters. We run frequent sitewide promotions and fulfillment costs keep rising. The CFO wants a plan to restore margin within 18 months without alienating loyal enthusiast customers.

Fulfillment and logistics costs per order have risen sharply while one of our warehouses sits half empty. We need a cost reduction plan for operations that protects delivery speed for customers over the next year.
Things are not going well. What should we do?

clarification_answers.q1: Raise gross margin by 3 points within 18 months

brief: Order volume grew 6% but revenue only grew 1% this year. Hospital purchasing groups seem to be squeezing our prices and national distributors are expanding into our states. We need to understand the pricing problem and what to do within a year.
Gross margin is down nearly seven points due to markdowns and rising fulfillment cost. Leadership wants prioritized, evidence-backed actions with owners and measurable targets for the next 12 months.

We must decide this quarter how to respond to falling gross margin: cut promotions, consolidate warehouses, or launch on third-party marketplaces. The board wants a recommendation with clear trade-offs.
